name: Aquatic Therapy
short: The only therapeutic pool in Oshkosh. Rehab with less stress on your joints.
metaDescription: Aquatic therapy in Oshkosh, WI. Fox Valley Physical Therapy has the only therapeutic pool in Oshkosh, for arthritis, post-surgical rehab, balance and pain.
intro: We're the only clinic in Oshkosh with a therapeutic pool. Water takes weight off healing joints, so you can start moving and strengthening sooner and with less pain than you could on land.

sections.heading: Aquatic Therapy Benefits
list: Water therapy provides buoyancy which takes the stress off of your joints while you exercise
Decreases muscle tightness and muscle spasms
Modulates pain and eases the effects of arthritis
Minimizes joint pain and inflammation to allow for better range of motion and overall function
Improves balance, walking, coordination and flexibility

sections.heading: Patients that could benefit
sections.body: Aquatic therapy works well post operative joint replacement, healing fractures, arthritic conditions, chronic back pain, fibromyalgia, and for poor balance and walking problems. Aquatic therapy is great for light resistance exercises that allows you to build strength without overloading areas that are still healing.

sections.heading: Privately scheduled pool sessions
sections.body: Current and former patients can reserve the pool for to continue their aquatic therapeutic exercise programs.

faq.question: Do I need to know how to swim?
faq.answer: No. Aquatic therapy is exercise in the water, not swimming laps, and your therapist is with you the whole time.

faq.question: Can I keep using the pool after therapy ends?
faq.answer: Yes. Current and former patients can reserve the pool for independent exercise. See the Pool page for details.
